propositions: Four graph functions have elevated cyclomatic complexity (16–22) driven by duplicated reduce-and-index loops and hand-rolled BFS skeletons
The exact pattern 'reduce_all_tickets → drop error/fsck_needed → index by id' appears verbatim in two locations (_find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph)
Two functions (_get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level) re-implement nearly identical BFS traversal skeletons with per-node reduce_ticket and neighbor filtering
Adding a shared load_indexed_states helper and pure bfs skeleton eliminates duplication while preserving node-set and traversal semantics
Refactoring must keep _ready.py, _status.py, and batch_close_operations untouched; graph unit and interface test suites must pass unchanged
